reviews.comment: Dr. Moulton is the best professor at A&M! He explains things thoroughly and encourages class discussions. He's very sweet and optimistic for the future of NDD treatments! He is passionate about the subject and he truly cares about his students. I learned so much in this class! The grading is a reflection of your effort, so it's very fair!

I appreciated his lecture style and grading was fair with feedback. Readings are a little complex but are helpful and he explains the subject really well. If you get the chance, take him for sure. The class is super interesting

Dr. Moulton is a great professor! Go to lectures, do the readings and you'll do great. He is a great lecturer, passionate about the subject matter, and clearly cares about his students. Neurodegenerative Diseases is not easy subject matter, but Dr. Moulton makes it manageable. Could not recommend this class enough!
